{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (0.00) and true prices show persistent downward drift.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high prices when sentiment history includes 0.33 (indicative of bullish momentum).",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if forecast overshoots true price by >5% after a spike, especially in the 3rd–5th day post-spike.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility when sentiment history is flat (all 0.00) and true prices show consolidation or downward trend.",
    "Shift forecast horizon downward by 1–2 days if true price drops sharply after a high forecast, especially with sentiment history showing 0.00.",
    "Increase forecast bias toward lower prices when true prices show strong downward momentum (e.g., >3 consecutive days below 70.00).",
    "Apply upward bias if sentiment history includes 0.33 and true price is below 65.00, indicating potential reversal."
  ]
}
